lang.non_utf8_fallback.en: [WARN] Non-UTF-8 console; falling back to English. Run 'chcp 65001' or use build.bat.
lang.non_utf8_fallback.zh_CN: [WARN] 控制台不是 UTF-8；已回退为英文。请执行 'chcp 65001' 或使用 build.bat。

preflight.cmake_too_old.zh_CN: [ERROR] 需要 CMake 3.24 或更高版本

preflight.cmake_too_old_hint.en: install CMake 3.24+ and make sure 'cmake --version' reports it
preflight.cmake_too_old_hint.zh_CN: 安装 CMake 3.24+，并确认 'cmake --version' 输出的版本正确

preflight.python_missing.en: [ERROR] Python 3.8+ not found (required by the Skia build)
preflight.python_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 Python 3.8+（Skia 构建需要）

preflight.python_missing_hint.en: install Python 3.8+ and add it to PATH, then retry
preflight.python_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 Python 3.8+ 并加入 PATH 后重试

preflight.python3_missing.en: [WARN]  'python3' not found; the Skia build requires the 'python3' command
preflight.python3_missing.zh_CN: [WARN]  未找到 'python3'；编译 Skia 需要 'python3' 命令

preflight.git_missing_hint.en: install Git and make sure 'git --version' works
preflight.git_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 Git 并确认 'git --version' 可用

preflight.ninja_missing_hint.en: install Ninja, use build.py (it locates the Ninja bundled with Visual Studio), or use -G "Visual Studio 17 2022"
preflight.ninja_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 Ninja，使用 build.py（会自动定位 Visual Studio 自带的 Ninja），或改用 -G "Visual Studio 17 2022"

preflight.gn_missing_hint.en: install gn, or use 'build.py deps' which prefers the gn bundled with the Skia tree
preflight.gn_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 gn，或使用 'build.py deps'（优先使用 Skia 源码树自带的 gn）

preflight.compiler_missing_hint.en: install gcc/g++ or clang/clang++ (C++20 capable) and make sure both are in PATH
preflight.compiler_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 gcc/g++ 或 clang/clang++（需支持 C++20），并确保两者都在 PATH 中

preflight.vs_missing.en: [ERROR] Visual Studio 2022+ with the C++ workload was not found
preflight.vs_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到安装了 C++ 工作负载的 Visual Studio 2022+

preflight.vs_missing_hint.en: install Visual Studio 2022 (or newer) with 'Desktop development with C++'
preflight.vs_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 Visual Studio 2022（或更新版本），并勾选“使用 C++ 的桌面开发”

preflight.vs_too_old.en: [ERROR] Visual Studio 2022 (MSVC v143) or newer is required
preflight.vs_too_old.zh_CN: [ERROR] 需要 Visual Studio 2022（MSVC v143）或更新版本

preflight.arch_unsupported_hint.en: use -DDUILIB_TARGET_ARCH=x64 (or arm64; x86 is Windows only)
preflight.arch_unsupported_hint.zh_CN: 使用 -DDUILIB_TARGET_ARCH=x64（或 arm64；x86 仅支持 Windows）

preflight.arch_mismatch.en: [ERROR] DUILIB_TARGET_ARCH does not match the configured toolchain
preflight.arch_mismatch.zh_CN: [ERROR] DUILIB_TARGET_ARCH 与当前工具链不一致

preflight.arch_mismatch_hint.en: reconfigure with a matching -A/-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER, or change DUILIB_TARGET_ARCH
preflight.arch_mismatch_hint.zh_CN: 使用匹配的 -A/-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER 重新配置，或修改 DUILIB_TARGET_ARCH

preflight.compiler_unsupported_hint.zh_CN: 请使用 MSVC 2022+、gcc/g++ 或 clang/clang++

preflight.cef_mingw.en: [ERROR] CEF is not available with MinGW/MSYS2 (MSVC ABI required)
preflight.cef_mingw.zh_CN: [ERROR] MinGW/MSYS2 不能使用 CEF（需要 MSVC ABI）

preflight.cef_mingw_hint.zh_CN: 使用 -DDUILIB_ENABLE_CEF=OFF，或改用 MSVC 构建

options.sdl_forced_on.en: [WARN] SDL is mandatory on this platform; DUILIB_ENABLE_SDL=OFF is ignored
options.sdl_forced_on.zh_CN: [WARN] 当前平台必须启用 SDL；DUILIB_ENABLE_SDL=OFF 已被忽略

options.cef_disabled_platform.en: [WARN] CEF is not supported on this platform or toolchain; CEF is disabled
options.cef_disabled_platform.zh_CN: [WARN] 当前平台或工具链不支持 CEF；已关闭 CEF

deps.lock_failed.en: [ERROR] another dependency preparation is already running
deps.lock_failed.zh_CN: [ERROR] 已有另一个依赖准备任务在运行

deps.lock_failed_hint.en: wait for it to finish; if no other build is running, remove the stale .duilib_deps.lock
deps.lock_failed_hint.zh_CN: 等待其完成；若没有其他构建在运行，删除陈旧的 .duilib_deps.lock

deps.versions_invalid_hint.en: check schemaVersion, skia/sdl/cef sections and the selected default entries
deps.versions_invalid_hint.zh_CN: 检查 schemaVersion、skia/sdl/cef 段以及 default 指向的条目

deps.ref_unknown.en: skia/sdl ref key '{key}' was not found in third_party_versions.json ({section})
deps.ref_unknown.zh_CN: third_party_versions.json 中不存在 {section} ref 键 '{key}'

deps.ref_unknown_hint.en: add the key under '{section}.refs' in the manifest, or pass a valid --skia-ref/--sdl-ref
deps.ref_unknown_hint.zh_CN: 在该清单的 '{section}.refs' 下补充对应键，或传入有效的 --skia-ref/--sdl-ref

deps.skia_source_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 Skia 源码树

deps.skia_source_missing_hint.en: run 'build.py deps' (needs network), or clone skia next to the repository
deps.skia_source_missing_hint.zh_CN: 执行 'build.py deps'（需要网络），或在仓库同级目录克隆 skia

deps.skia_building.zh_CN: [deps] 正在用 gn/ninja 编译 Skia

deps.python3_missing.en: [ERROR] 'python3' not found; the Skia build invokes 'python3' directly
deps.python3_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 'python3'；Skia 的构建脚本固定调用 'python3'

deps.python3_missing_hint.en: Skia does not accept 'python' or 'py -3': install Python 3 and make sure 'python3 --version' works
deps.python3_missing_hint.zh_CN: Skia 不认 'python' 或 'py -3'：请安装 Python 3，并确认 'python3 --version' 可用

deps.skia_gn_failed.en: [ERROR] Skia configure failed: {gn} gen out/{variant} returned {rc}
deps.skia_gn_failed.zh_CN: [ERROR] Skia 配置失败：{gn} gen out/{variant} 返回 {rc}

deps.skia_gn_failed_hint.en: Linux/macOS must use the native gn (not bin/gn.exe); install gn or pass -DDUILIB_GN_EXECUTABLE=<path>
deps.skia_gn_failed_hint.zh_CN: Linux/macOS 必须使用本机 gn（不能是 bin/gn.exe）；请安装 gn 或传入 -DDUILIB_GN_EXECUTABLE=<path>

deps.skia_failed_hint.en: check the gn/ninja output above, then run 'build.py deps --force'
deps.skia_failed_hint.zh_CN: 查看上面的 gn/ninja 输出，然后执行 'build.py deps --force'

deps.skia_patch_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 Skia 补丁包

deps.skia_patch_missing_hint.zh_CN: 检查 third_party_versions.json 中的 DUILIB_SKIA_PATCH_ZIP / DUILIB_SKIA_COMPILE_ROOT

deps.skia_patch_fetching.zh_CN: [deps] 正在克隆 skia_compile 仓库

deps.skia_patch_updating.zh_CN: [deps] 正在更新 skia_compile 仓库

deps.skia_patch_update_failed.en: skia_compile update failed, continuing with the local copy
deps.skia_patch_update_failed.zh_CN: skia_compile 更新失败，继续使用本地已有内容

deps.skia_patch_restoring.en: [deps] restoring the patch archive from the skia_compile checkout
deps.skia_patch_restoring.zh_CN: [deps] 正在从 skia_compile 仓库恢复补丁包

deps.skia_patch_restore_failed.en: failed to restore the patch archive from skia_compile
deps.skia_patch_restore_failed.zh_CN: 从 skia_compile 仓库恢复补丁包失败

deps.skia_patch_changed.en: [deps] the Skia patch archive changed, rebuilding Skia
deps.skia_patch_changed.zh_CN: [deps] Skia 补丁包已更新，重新编译 Skia

deps.git_ref_switching.en: [deps] local source is not at the manifest ref, switching
deps.git_ref_switching.zh_CN: [deps] 本地源码与版本清单不一致，正在切换

deps.skia_patch_fetch_failed_hint.en: check network access, or clone https://github.com/rhett-lee/skia_compile.git into DUILIB_SKIA_COMPILE_ROOT manually
deps.skia_patch_fetch_failed_hint.zh_CN: 检查网络连接，或手工把 https://github.com/rhett-lee/skia_compile.git 克隆到 DUILIB_SKIA_COMPILE_ROOT

deps.skia_patch_dir_invalid.en: [ERROR] the skia_compile directory exists but is not a git checkout
deps.skia_patch_dir_invalid.zh_CN: [ERROR] skia_compile 目录已存在，但不是 git 仓库

deps.skia_patch_dir_invalid_hint.en: remove that directory, or clone https://github.com/rhett-lee/skia_compile.git into it manually
deps.skia_patch_dir_invalid_hint.zh_CN: 删除该目录，或手工把 https://github.com/rhett-lee/skia_compile.git 克隆进去

deps.retry.zh_CN: [deps] {what} 失败（第 {attempt} 次），{delay} 秒后重试

deps.sdl_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 SDL3 安装目录

deps.sdl_missing_hint.en: run 'build.py deps', or pass -DDUILIB_SDL_ROOT=<installed SDL3 prefix>
deps.sdl_missing_hint.zh_CN: 执行 'build.py deps'，或传入 -DDUILIB_SDL_ROOT=<已安装的 SDL3 前缀>

deps.sdl_failed_hint.en: check the SDL3 build output above, then run 'build.py deps --force'
deps.sdl_failed_hint.zh_CN: 查看上面的 SDL3 输出，然后执行 'build.py deps --force'

deps.sdl_multi_config.en: [deps] multi-config generator: building SDL3 for Debug and Release; Release is installed last, so Debug targets link the Release static library (use Ninja for per-config SDL3)
deps.sdl_multi_config.zh_CN: [deps] 多配置生成器：Debug 与 Release 都会编译 SDL3；Release 最后安装，因此 Debug 目标链接的是 Release 静态库（需要按配置区分时请改用 Ninja）

deps.cef_combo_missing.en: [ERROR] CEF archive is not configured for this version/platform/architecture
deps.cef_combo_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 清单中没有该 CEF 版本/平台/架构的下载包

deps.cef_combo_missing_hint.en: add an archives entry in cmake/third_party_versions.json or choose another DUILIB_CEF_VERSION
deps.cef_combo_missing_hint.zh_CN: 在 cmake/third_party_versions.json 中补充 archives 条目，或改选 DUILIB_CEF_VERSION

deps.cef_downloading.zh_CN: [deps] 正在下载 CEF 运行时

deps.cef_sha1_fetching.en: [deps] fetching the official SHA1 for the CEF archive
deps.cef_sha1_fetching.zh_CN: [deps] 正在获取 CEF 下载包的官方 SHA1

deps.cef_download_failed_hint.en: use '--offline' with a cached archive, or pass -DDUILIB_CEF_ARCHIVE=<local file>
deps.cef_download_failed_hint.zh_CN: 使用 '--offline' 配合已缓存的包，或传入 -DDUILIB_CEF_ARCHIVE=<本地文件>

deps.cef_hash_mismatch.zh_CN: [ERROR] CEF 下载包校验值不匹配

deps.cef_hash_mismatch_hint.en: delete the cached archive and retry; if it persists, compare it with the .sha1 published by CEF, or fix the sha256 in third_party_versions.json
deps.cef_hash_mismatch_hint.zh_CN: 删除缓存的下载包后重试；若仍失败，请与 CEF 官方发布的 .sha1 比对，或修正 third_party_versions.json 中的 sha256

deps.cef_no_sha.en: [WARN] no SHA1 (and no sha256 in the manifest) is available for this CEF archive; integrity check skipped
deps.cef_no_sha.zh_CN: [WARN] 未能获取该 CEF 下载包的 SHA1（版本清单也未配置 sha256）；已跳过完整性校验

deps.cef_version_mismatch.zh_CN: [ERROR] CEF 运行时与仓库头文件版本不一致

deps.cef_version_mismatch_hint.en: use a matching DUILIB_CEF_VERSION, or update the tracked libcef headers
deps.cef_version_mismatch_hint.zh_CN: 改用匹配的 DUILIB_CEF_VERSION，或更新仓库内的 libcef 头文件

deps.cef_extract_failed.en: [ERROR] failed to extract the CEF archive
deps.cef_extract_failed.zh_CN: [ERROR] 解压 CEF 下载包失败

deps.cef_extract_failed_hint.en: check free disk space and the archive integrity, then retry
deps.cef_extract_failed_hint.zh_CN: 检查磁盘空间与下载包完整性后重试

deps.offline_missing.en: [ERROR] --offline was requested but the dependency is not cached
deps.offline_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 指定了 --offline，但依赖尚未缓存

deps.offline_missing_hint.en: drop --offline once to prepare the dependency, or point the cache variables at existing files
deps.offline_missing_hint.zh_CN: 去掉 --offline 准备一次依赖，或把缓存变量指向已有文件

deps.crt_mismatch.en: [ERROR] CRT mismatch between the current build and prepared dependencies
deps.crt_mismatch.zh_CN: [ERROR] 当前构建与已准备依赖的 CRT 不一致

deps.crt_mismatch_hint.en: re-run 'build.py deps' with the same DUILIB_MD/toolchain, or use a separate build directory
deps.crt_mismatch_hint.zh_CN: 使用相同的 DUILIB_MD/工具链重新执行 'build.py deps'，或改用独立的构建目录

build.toolchain_changed.en: [build] compiler changed in {dir}: {cached} -> {expected}; discarding the stale CMake cache
build.toolchain_changed.zh_CN: [build] 检测到 {dir} 的编译器已切换：{cached} → {expected}，将清理旧的 CMake 缓存

build.config_switch.en: [build] bin/ holds {stale} example outputs from another configuration; removing {count} target(s) so {config} relinks
build.config_switch.zh_CN: [build] bin/ 中是 {stale} 配置的示例产物；删除 {count} 个目标，强制 {config} 重新链接

build.failed_hint.en: check the compiler output above, then re-run the same command
build.failed_hint.zh_CN: 查看上面的编译输出，然后重新执行同一命令

build.cef_archive_missing.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到 CEF 归档文件

build.python_missing_hint.en: install Python 3.8+ (required by the Skia build) and retry
build.python_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 Python 3.8+（Skia 构建需要）后重试

build.cmake_missing_hint.en: install CMake 3.24+ and add it to PATH
build.cmake_missing_hint.zh_CN: 安装 CMake 3.24+ 并加入 PATH

build.invalid_config.en: [ERROR] invalid configuration; expected Debug or Release
build.invalid_config.zh_CN: [ERROR] 配置无效；应为 Debug 或 Release

build.no_products.en: [ERROR] no build products found; run 'build.py build' first
build.no_products.zh_CN: [ERROR] 未找到构建产物；请先执行 'build.py build'

build.clean_deps_done.en: [OK] dependency build products removed (source clones kept)
build.clean_deps_done.zh_CN: [OK] 依赖构建产物已删除（保留源码克隆）

build.clean_failed_hint.en: close programs that use the build tree (editors, running examples, antivirus) and retry
build.clean_failed_hint.zh_CN: 请关闭占用构建树的程序（编辑器、正在运行的示例、杀毒软件）后重试

doctor.cmake_missing.en: [WARN] cmake not found; using the built-in Python checks
doctor.cmake_missing.zh_CN: [WARN] 未找到 cmake；改用 Python 内置探测

test.failed_hint.zh_CN: 查看上面的 unittest 输出

pack.failed_hint.zh_CN: 查看上面的 pack.py 输出

pack.sdl_flag_hint.en: [HINT] --sdl only enables SDL for the build; add --with-sdl to include SDL3 in the package
pack.sdl_flag_hint.zh_CN: [提示] --sdl 只影响编译开关；包内包含 SDL3 需要额外加 --with-sdl
